borderline_drops.title: Craneware plc healthcare-billing vendor breach
borderline_drops.reason: European (Edinburgh) domicile but customer base exclusively US healthcare billing/pharmacy; no plausible Swiss/EU customer exposure, no access vector disclosed (no transferable TTP), contained with company-assessed 'largely non-sensitive' data; only lesson is generic supply-chain awareness. Recover if a Swiss/EU Trisus/Sentry customer or a forensic post-mortem surfaces.

Clop's EBS campaign (with a reported Swiss victim, Logitech) is a candidate for the weekly strategic lens if fresh in-window CH/EU-specific reporting appears.
